## speed-sol2-small: the persisted type table's writer ~3x its bound (solver-sync speed-of-light section 5)

- Where: `crates/hir-ty/src/next_solver/persist.rs`, the writer's `FxHashMap` from a value to its place in the table being written (~30 cycles a probe; 10^4 values ~86 us).
- Change: a column indexed by the value's global row (a `u32` per row, in a reused per-thread `Vec` that the writer resets by the rows it set), one line per value instead of a hash and a probe, ~10 cycles. Same bytes written (same order: first visit), so a round-trip test and a byte-equality test against today's writer over the fixtures.
- Matters on a cold build and when many results change; a warm build writes only changed results.
